data.display_address: Canal Front Residence 9, Canal Front Residences, Al Wasl, Dubai
data.long_description:
Canal Front Residences is a premium waterfront development located directly along the Dubai Water Canal, offering a serene lifestyle with seamless access to urban conveniences. Set beside Safa Park, the community delivers a perfect blend of greenery, water views, and modern city living. Each residence features contemporary interiors, spacious layouts, and large windows designed to maximize natural light and scenic vistas of the canal, park, and skyline. The development ensures a refined living experience with elegant finishes and thoughtfully designed spaces that emphasize comfort and style.

Features

Modern architectural design with waterfront and park views
Spacious layouts with bright, open interiors
Floor-to-ceiling windows for enhanced natural light
Contemporary finishes with high-quality materials
Fully equipped kitchens with built-in appliances
Large balconies or terraces offering scenic outdoor space
Secure and covered parking for residents
24/7 security and CCTV monitoring throughout the community

Amenities

Swimming pool with leisure deck
Fully equipped fitness center
Landscaped garden areas
Canal-side jogging and cycling tracks
Children’s play areas
Outdoor leisure spaces and seating zones
Direct access to the waterfront promenade
Nearby retail, cafés, and dining options
Easy connectivity to major roads and key destinations in Dubai
